metaTitle: Custom Frosted Pen Pencil Cases | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Shop custom frosted pen pencil cases at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for sleek, semi-transparent branding. Order bulk for your team or event.
introHtml: Frosted pen pencil cases offer a modern, semi-transparent look that adds a subtle, professional sheen to your branding. Unlike clear cases, the frosted finish hides minor scuffs and fingerprints while still showing off the contents inside. Perfect for trade show giveaways or employee kits, these cases accept screen printing or debossing for a clean logo placement. Choose from multiple sizes to fit standard pens, pencils, or small accessories.
heroAltText: Custom frosted pen pencil cases with screen-printed logo, semi-transparent finish, bulk order for corporate events
